parsed.explanation: Enforced criminalisation of consensual same-sex conduct is here a trans-facing lever because police are documented to use violence/harassment, prolonged detention and extortion based on gender identity and orientation, officials offer no protection, and presidential hostility incited hate speech/assaults. If outed, a trans visitor faces long imprisonment, coercive detention, possible degrading sexual examination historically used in prosecutions (current continuation unresolved), and mob/police abuse with no effective recourse. Absence of trans-specific border/facility rules and dated incidents weaken certainty; no executions documented. State-directed coercion and severity place it in severe risk, somewhat above explicit anti-trans sweep examples because trans visitor targeting is less directly documented.
